The first v2 policy (2026-10-24) trusted the owner account as its reviewer and named the pusd-token-list release; its binding of the v1 report was never listed on v2. Superseded on 2026-10-25 by this role-separated policy on the pusd-catalog-v2 release. The binding is kept as history.

rule: An entry is available only when its latest binding evaluates to valid under this policy and the published fields equal the approved report field by field. A valid evaluation with a differing configured entry withholds the entry and names the field.
caveat: An available entry means the policy held at the recorded checkpoints and time. The roles above say who controls each account; this catalog does not establish independent review or adoption.
